import sys
from collections import defaultdict, deque

# Read the number of vertices in the tree
n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())

# Read the edges of the tree
tree = defaultdict(list)
for _ in range(n - 1):
    x, y = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split())
    tree[x].append(y)
    tree[y].append(x)

# Find the leaves of the tree
leaves = [node for node, children in tree.items() if len(children) == 1]

# Calculate the minimal time required for all ants to be in the root of the tree
time_required = 0

# Use BFS to find the depth of each leaf
depths = {}
queue = deque(leaves)
while queue:
    node = queue.popleft()
    for child in tree[node]:
        if child not in depths:
            depths[child] = depths[node] + 1
            queue.append(child)

# The minimal time required is the maximum depth of any leaf
time_required = max(depths.values())

# Output the result
print(time_required)
